item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately continues advisory committees, delegates presidential advisory-committee functions to designated agency heads, and makes related administrative revocations and supersessions; these are internal organizational actions rather than changes to legal rights.","evidence":"Each advisory committee listed below is continued until September 30, 2007."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately amends an earlier executive order's provisions governing an advisory council, an internal administrative reorganization.","evidence":"Section 3 of Executive Order 13231, as amended, is further amended"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The provision directs the NIAC to advise the President and prescribes its composition; these are ongoing advisory and staffing functions without a dictated legal outcome.","evidence":"shall provide the President through the Secretary of Homeland Security with advice"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The provision sets internal eligibility and designation rules for NIAC leadership, with appointments occurring through later presidential action.","evidence":"The President shall designate from among the members of the NIAC a Chair and a Vice Chair"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The provision assigns succession, meeting, monitoring, reporting, and recommendation duties to the NIAC; these are internal advisory functions with no specified legal consequence.","evidence":"The NIAC shall meet periodically"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The provision requires internal reporting, inter-office coordination, and agency advice, all of which are administrative processes rather than legally consequential outcomes.","evidence":"shall ensure appropriate coordination"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The provision limits the subject matter on which the NIAC may advise or act while implementing the order, an internal allocation of advisory authority effective under the order.","evidence":"the NIAC shall not advise or otherwise act on matters pertaining to National Security and Emergency Preparedness (NS/EP) Communications"},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The provision requires coordination between federal advisory committees during implementation, without prescribing a legal consequence for outside parties.","evidence":"shall coordinate with the National Security and Telecommunications Advisory Committee"},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately amends an executive order governing administrative support and grants the Director discretionary authority to provide later project support after consultation, without dictating that support be provided.","evidence":"Additional project support may be provided"},{"segment_id":"10","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and specifies the membership of an advisory committee, while assigning the Secretary of Labor a later designation function; this is internal organization and staffing.","evidence":"There is established the President's Committee on the International Labor Organization (ILO)."},{"segment_id":"11","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately changes an advisory council's membership limits and statutory advisory role, revokes a prior executive order, and sets the order's effective date; these are internal administrative amendments rather than substantive legal consequences.","evidence":"PCAST shall serve as the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee"}]}
